# airs supplychain

```text
AI Supply Chain agent and skill scan telemetry (experimental, OAuth)

Usage: airs supplychain [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  report  Generate an aggregate-only 30-day HTML report
  rules   Rule catalog (not effective tenant policy)
  scans   Inspect agent and skill scans (read-only)
  stats   Read server rolling 30-day skill statistics
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --output <format>  Output format: pretty, table, json
      --quiet            Suppress status and decorative output (data and errors still print)
      --debug            Write redacted API diagnostics to a private JSONL file
      --tenant <name>    Use this registered tenant for one invocation without changing the selection
  -h, --help             Print help
```

## airs supplychain report

```text
Generate an aggregate-only 30-day HTML report

Usage: airs supplychain report [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --max-pages <n>       Page budget per inventory (1–100, 10 rows/page) (default: 40)
      --output <format>     Refused by this command: the report is written as HTML (omit --output)
      --output-file <path>  New file in CWD by default; - for stdout; never overwrite
      --quiet               Suppress status and decorative output (data and errors still print)
      --debug               Write redacted API diagnostics to a private JSONL file
      --strict              Exit 1 after writing if any source is incomplete
      --tenant <name>       Use this registered tenant for one invocation without changing the selection
      --title <text>        Report title (default: "Supply chain environment report")
  -h, --help                Print help
```
